map.note: Each alternate reading token is a true lexical token with its own surface form and variant_word_of link; its oslots is an ANCHOR to the primary reading, not occurrence identity
word is the TF slot type including 2462 synthetic empty reading-gap anchors; a blanket Token category would falsely classify empty positional anchors
Reading is an apparatus alternative, not a selected token, physical manuscript or lexical sense
Manuscript is a source witness metadata node, not an identified physical artifact or LRMoo Item
Book node identifies a source version or generated translation; without conditional semantics cannot assert LRMoo Work, Expression, Manifestation or Item
Technical empty textual anchor; contains no source word string and must not be classed as a token
Source version provenance is not an ontology Work/Expression individual or source identity crosswalk
Generated translation is not a historical manuscript witness and not automatically an LRMoo Work/Expression identity
Explicit generated translation to source-version book relation; do not invent an unpinned Work/Expression LRMoo relation
Alternative token points to its source apparatus reading; not an ontological word-identity or witness attribution
